preamble: Monophthongization of a nasalized [ai] diphthong to a nasalized front mid vowel. In French, Latin stressed a before a nasal (when not preceded by a palatal) became Old French /ai̯/ (manum > main, pānem > pain, famem > faim). The diphthong was nasalized and then monophthongized, giving Modern French /ɛ̃/ (Quebec [ẽɪ̯̃]). The atlas has no separate symbol for open-mid nasal [ɛ̃], so this cell records the French outcome.

examples.note: Wikipedia gives the change as /ãĩ/ > /ɛ̃/ for pain.
Before a nasal, Latin [aː] became /ai̯/ unless a palatalized consonant preceded it (manum, amat > OF main, aime).
